ACS37010_LZ_SOIC6.description: Allegro ACS37010/ACS37012 custom 6-pin SOIC LZ package resolver rule.

footprint_rule.coordinate_system: KiCad footprint top view, positive Y down
footprint_rule.pad_coordinate_derivation: Use datasheet land-pattern pad sizes, pitch, and row spacing. Put signal pads on one row and high-current pads on the opposite row.
footprint_rule.pad_numbering_policy: Candidate numbering from pinout and pin-1 marker; requires explicit review because the land-pattern drawing does not print pad numbers.
footprint_rule.silkscreen_policy: Use body-edge marker segments outside pad copper; add pin-1 marker only after orientation review.

GENERIC_EXPLICIT_PADS.description: Use an explicit KiCad-compatible pad list from the normalized extraction.

footprint_rule.coordinate_system: KiCad footprint top view, positive Y down
footprint_rule.silkscreen_policy: Derive simple silkscreen/fab/courtyard rectangles unless supplied explicitly.

GENERIC_DUAL_ROW_SMD.description: Generic draft generator for even-pin-count dual-row SMD packages such as SOIC, SOP, SSOP, TSSOP, MSOP, and similar packages.

footprint_rule.coordinate_system: KiCad footprint top view, positive Y down
footprint_rule.pad_numbering_policy: Draft JEDEC-style counter-clockwise numbering; requires orientation review unless explicit pad mapping is provided.

GENERIC_SOT_SMD.description: Generic draft generator for SOT-23/SOT-23-5/SOT-23-6 style packages.

footprint_rule.coordinate_system: KiCad footprint top view, positive Y down
footprint_rule.pad_numbering_policy: Draft SOT-style numbering; requires orientation review unless exact pads are supplied.

GENERIC_QFN_DFN.description: Generic draft generator for QFN/DFN/LGA no-lead packages. Use explicit pads when possible.

footprint_rule.coordinate_system: KiCad footprint top view, positive Y down
footprint_rule.pad_numbering_policy: Draft quad-side numbering and optional exposed pad; requires orientation review unless exact pads are supplied.
